our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that recognizable, impressive generated scenes also contain basic semantic or physical errors. The reference to superintelligence is figurative.

criteria.support_condition: The original demonstrations, or reliable independent descriptions of them, establish recognizable generated scenes alongside basic semantic or physical errors.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable inspection establishes that the alleged defects are absent or misdescribed and that the cited demonstrations do not exhibit comparable basic errors.
